stories.title: Nepal flood death toll climbs to 675 as nearly 2,400 remain missing
stories.reason: A glacier collapse near Langtang Lirung unleashed the flood five days ago, and rescuers are still struggling to reach devastated Himalayan valleys as the toll keeps rising, including around 90 missing Americans.

stories.title: Israel-Hamas truce failure would be a 'point of no return,' US envoy warns
stories.reason: The official leading Trump's Gaza peace effort is publicly warning the fragile ceasefire could collapse for good, even as Israeli strikes continue to kill Palestinians in the enclave almost daily.

stories.title: Meta reaches $16.68 billion settlement in teen social media safety case
stories.reason: Ending a trial brought by 29 states over allegations Facebook and Instagram were engineered to be addictive to kids, Meta must now add daily time caps and overnight limits for teen accounts nationwide.

stories.title: SpaceX announces $100 billion Starbase Louisiana spaceport
stories.reason: The largest capital investment in Louisiana's history would give SpaceX a second Starship campus with five launch complexes, underscoring how fast the company is scaling beyond Texas.

stories.title: US inflation rises in August as firms pass tariff costs on to consumers
stories.reason: Core inflation is stuck at 3.3%, well above the Fed's target, as tariff-hit categories like apparel keep getting more expensive -- complicating Chair Warsh's path to rate cuts.

stories.title: 2026 tech layoffs hit 127,180 across 281 companies, already topping all of 2025
stories.reason: Cuts at Apple, TikTok, LinkedIn and Netflix push this year's tech job losses past last year's total, a sign AI-driven restructuring is accelerating rather than slowing down.

stories.title: OpenAI says unreleased model Astra solved 10 open problems in mathematics
stories.reason: Astra reportedly produced the first-ever proof that non-sofic groups exist, a question open for 27 years, plus a sphere-packing bound unimproved since 1978 -- for under $2,000 in compute, with every step machine-verified.

stories.title: OpenAI retires the original DALL-E tool from ChatGPT
stories.reason: One of the earliest mainstream generative-AI tools disappears today as OpenAI consolidates image generation into ChatGPT Images, marking the end of a product that helped kick off the AI image boom.
